patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three swing lows visible: left shoulder near 1760, head near 1720, right shoulder near 1780-1790. Price rallied above neckline resistance to approximately 1840 and is now pulling back to test the breakout area around 1809.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulsive rally from approximately 1720 to 1840 followed by a shallow pullback to current price near 1809, consistent with early flag formation after an impulsive move.

patterns_found.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish structure invalidated by bullish impulse breaking above swing high near 1800-1810 after establishing a higher low around 1780-1790. Current price near 1809 is holding above the BOS level.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price formed a higher low near 1780-1790 after the 1720 swing low, then rallied to approximately 1840 breaking prior resistance. Current pullback to 1809 appears to be testing the breakout area.
